import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import stability
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--profile',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
server=root/'artifacts/baselines/ip-admission/war-relay'
client=root/'artifacts/baselines/address-churn-client/stress'
source=client.parent/'stress.rs';assert sha(source)==sha(root/'examples/stress.rs')
prefix='address-churn-profile' if args.profile else 'address-churn-comparison'
output=root/f'docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-{prefix}.json'
record={'recorded_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope':'32 concurrent workers perform fully verified connect/join/16-byte worker+counter self-echo/exact empty Close acknowledgement/TCP EOF cycles. Latency includes the full lifecycle. Both source pools bind explicit127.64.x.y addresses on an IPv4 loopback ws:// URL. Source pool4096 assigns disjoint rotating subsets to workers; pool1 shares one address. Native admission limit0/64; all workloads fit the enabled quota. Same frozen client and server; four server workers CPUs0-3/client CPUs4-7. Eight-second cases, exact lifecycle/message/delivery/value-byte counters, resource/error cleanup. Ordinary comparisons rotate pool/role order across three repetitions and exclude builds/profiles/competing loads. Prior8-byte stress counts and connect-to-echo latency are not equivalent to this stronger contract.',
    'profile_diagnostic':args.profile,'runtime_source_revision':'ef3d8fcd3826fbc6a4110167a792867dbf05dfd1',
    'server':{'path':str(server.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(server)},
    'client':{'path':str(client.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(client),'source_path':str(source.relative_to(root)),'source_sha256':sha(source)},
    'helpers':{str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in [root/'scripts/stability.py',root/'scripts/benchmark.py']},
    'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'driver_sha256':sha(__file__),'cases':[],'passed':False}
jobs=[(1,4096,'enabled')] if args.profile else [
    (rep,pool,role) for rep in range(1,4)
    for pool in ([1,4096] if rep%2 else [4096,1])
    for role in (['disabled','enabled'] if rep%2 else ['enabled','disabled'])]
for rep,pool,role in jobs:
    trace=output.with_name(f'{output.stem}-{pool}-{role}-{rep}.json')
    perf_path=trace.with_suffix('.perf.data')
    recorder=None;perf_log=None;original_sample=stability.sample
    def sample(pid,admin,started):
        global recorder,perf_log
        result=original_sample(pid,admin,started)
        if args.profile and recorder is None:
            perf_log=tempfile.TemporaryFile()
            recorder=subprocess.Popen(['perf','record','-e','cycles:u','-F','499','--call-graph','dwarf,8192',
                '-p',str(pid),'-o',str(perf_path)],stdout=perf_log,stderr=perf_log)
            time.sleep(.1);assert recorder.poll() is None,'perf recorder could not attach'
        return result
    try:
        stability.sample=sample
        case=stability.run_case('churn',8,32,server_binary=server,stress_binary=client,
            server_cpus='0-3',client_cpus='4-7',server_args=['--max-connections-per-ip','64' if role=='enabled' else '0'],source_addresses=pool)
    finally:
        stability.sample=original_sample
        if recorder is not None:
            if recorder.poll() is None:recorder.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
            perf_exit=recorder.wait(timeout=10)
            perf_log.seek(0);perf_text=perf_log.read().decode();perf_log.close()
    assert case['passed'] and case['server_exit_code']==case['exit_code']==0
    metrics=case['final']['metrics'];result=case['output'][-1];cycles=result['verified_deliveries']
    assert result['payload_bytes']==16 and result['source_addresses']==pool
    assert int(metrics['war_accepted_total'])==int(metrics['war_joined_total'])==int(metrics['war_disconnected_total'])==cycles
    assert int(metrics['war_incoming_messages_total'])==cycles and int(metrics['war_deliveries_total'])==2*cycles
    assert int(metrics['war_routing_reused_bytes_total'])==17*cycles
    for key in ['war_connections','war_sessions','war_queued_bytes','war_variable_bytes','war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes',
                'war_output_queue_capacity_bytes','war_ip_rejected_total','war_routing_copied_bytes_total',
                'war_handshake_errors_total','war_protocol_errors_total','war_write_errors_total','war_close_failures_total',
                'war_transport_disconnects_total','war_rejected_total']:
        assert int(metrics[key])==0,key
    case['profile_diagnostic']=args.profile
    trace.write_text(json.dumps(case,indent=2)+'\n')
    if args.profile:
        assert perf_exit in (0,-signal.SIGINT),perf_text
        report_path=trace.with_suffix('.perf.txt')
        report=subprocess.run(['perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','-g','none','--sort','symbol','--percent-limit','0.1',
            '-i',str(perf_path)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        report_path.write_text(report.stdout)
        symbols=[]
        for line in report.stdout.splitlines():
            match=re.match(r'^\s*([0-9.]+)%\s+\[(.)\]\s+(.+)$',line)
            if match:symbols.append({'self_user_cycles_percent':float(match[1]),'kind':match[2],'symbol':match[3]})
        record['profile']={'event':'cycles:u','frequency_hz':499,'call_graph':'dwarf,8192','perf_exit_code':perf_exit,
            'recorder_log':perf_text,'report_stderr':report.stderr,
            'data':{'path':str(perf_path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(perf_path)},
            'report':{'path':str(report_path.relative_to(root)),'sha256':sha(report_path)},'symbols':symbols}
    trace.write_text(json.dumps(case,indent=2)+'\n')
    cpu=case['final']['process']['cpu_seconds']-case['baseline']['process']['cpu_seconds']
    row={'kind':role,'source_addresses':pool,'repetition':rep,'trace':str(trace.relative_to(root)),
        'trace_sha256':sha(trace),'cycles':cycles,'per_second':result['deliveries_per_second'],
        'p99_ms':result['latency_p99_upper_ms'],'cpu_seconds':cpu,'cpu_ns_per_cycle':cpu*1e9/cycles,
        'sampled_peak_rss_mib':max(s['process']['VmRSS'] for s in [case['baseline'],*case['samples'],case['final']])/1024,'passed':True}
    record['cases'].append(row);output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
if not args.profile:
    record['medians']={}
    for pool in [1,4096]:
        for role in ['disabled','enabled']:
            rows=[r for r in record['cases'] if r['source_addresses']==pool and r['kind']==role]
            keys=['per_second','p99_ms','cpu_seconds','cpu_ns_per_cycle','sampled_peak_rss_mib']
            summary={k:statistics.median(r[k] for r in rows) for k in keys}
            summary['ranges']={k:[min(r[k] for r in rows),max(r[k] for r in rows)] for k in keys}
            record['medians'][f'{pool}/{role}']=summary
record['passed']=True;output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
if not args.profile:print(json.dumps(record['medians']),flush=True)
